sections.heading: Overview
bullets: Tank-and-spank with two add phases (66% / 33%) and a group-wide coordination check. Enrage grants Samarog a 500% damage buff — treat any enrage as a wipe.

sections.heading: Samarog's attacks
bullets: Shockwave: an expanding knockback from both spears — dodge or jump it, it can't be blocked.
Spear placement: spears planted around the arena apply taunt or fear — being caught in the placement's blast does roughly 80% of your max HP, so don't stand near a spear when it lands.
Inevitable Betrayal: two players need to overlap their green circles before the orange circle fills, or everyone nearby takes heavy damage.
Brutalize: Samarog pins a target and channels damage on them — break his defiance bar fast to cut it short before it ramps up.

sections.heading: Add phases (66% / 33%)
bullets: Two adds spawn — Guldhem (jotun) and Rigom (human). CC and kill priority matters here; don't let both run loose while ignoring mechanics on Samarog.
Keep the group tight but not stacked — the spear/shockwave mechanics punish clumping just as much as being spread wrong.

sections.heading: Enrage
bullets: No fixed timer listed, but the enrage buff (+500% damage) is an effective hard wall — a slow group should call it and reset rather than push through.
